title: Ford's new NSA intelligence system

tellings.quote: But first of all, we want you to arrange with the NSA a new intelligence system

plain: A former presidential advisor named Harald Malmgren says that in 1974 at the White House, President Gerald Ford asked him to arrange a new intelligence system with the National Security Agency, the US agency that intercepts and analyses communications. Malmgren tells this as something he was personally asked to do. If true, it would place him inside the president's intelligence planning at that time.
